title: MIT-WPU delivery portal
subtitle: All workstreams, planned in waves. Agents advance items as they land.

waves.title: Content migration
waves.summary: Move the university's public content into the new site, with evidence retained.

items.title: Migrate all public routes (Pune + Goa)
items.note: ~1,900 Pune routes + 164 Goa routes rebuilt from the retained crawl.

items.title: People directory and canonical profiles
items.note: 516 profiles; taxonomy keeps faculty, postdocs, scholars and technical staff distinct.

items.title: Document library (PDFs) mapped and served
items.note: 602 documents mapped to local paths; 44 absent Goa PDFs retained as unavailable evidence.

items.title: Image and media pipeline
items.note: Optimised derivatives, provenance manifest, no remote first-party media.

items.title: WPU Goa site rebuilt
items.note: 164 routes, campus theme, programmes and advisers.

waves.title: Structure and audiences
waves.summary: Give the site the entry points it was missing: audience hubs, section hubs, and real content where pages were stubs.

items.title: Student resources hub
items.note: 115 course-structure PDFs organised by school, plus ordinances, exams, handbooks and support.

items.title: Faculty & staff hub
items.note: Combined audience hub with an intranet sign-in gateway.

items.title: Admissions gateway
items.note: Pathways, application steps, entrance test, scholarships, downloads.

items.title: Campus life hub
items.note: Grew from a 3-card stub to an 8-card hub, 28 real links.

items.title: International hub
items.note: Six themed groups; partnerships and support routed to real pages.

items.title: Fill broken content stubs
items.note: Nine school and research index pages filled from canonical unit data.

items.title: Careers page (CRF faculty search)
items.note: Registered as a curated route so rebuilds preserve it.

waves.title: Navigation and design
waves.summary: Make a large site navigable, and make the pages read like a university rather than a brochure.

items.title: Dropdowns that stay open (hover-intent)
items.note: Single-controller open state with a close delay; verified across repeated open/hold/reopen cycles.

items.title: Two-level cascading fly-out navigation
items.note: Two-level fly-out live; 129/129 headless checks pass, edge-aware, mobile accordion.

items.title: Cascade pattern in the shared template
items.note: university-web-patterns v0.6.0, data-free and validated.

items.title: Full-page landing sections
items.note: Homepage and section pages open on a complete view rather than a mid-page break.

items.title: Editorial images, not promotional banners
items.note: Admissions hero moved from a CET poster to a campus photograph.

items.title: Person-first ordering on leadership pages
items.note: Founder President and siblings currently show the message before the person.

items.title: Official campus map
items.note: Fabricated illustration replaced with the university's official layout; TikZ 2D + 3D renders in progress.

waves.title: Depth and review
waves.summary: Improve what exists: verified crawls, external review, and content quality passes.

items.title: Full verification crawl
items.note: 4,334 rendered pages, zero issues; interactions tested at desktop and mobile.

items.title: Improvement crawl across six slices
items.note: Programmes, people, hubs, about-us, Goa and the scheduler — real corrections only, no invented content.

items.title: External review actions
items.note: Reviewer comments triaged against the current build; programme tables and formatting outstanding.

items.title: Remove duplicated navigation entries
items.note: People menu no longer repeats About Us governance links.

items.title: Goa depth pass
items.note: Continuing with the best retained public data today; authoritative bios and approved images will be reconciled during tomorrow's migration.

waves.title: Faculty search
waves.summary: Recruit research faculty for the Central Research Facility and the physics cluster.

items.title: CRF recruitment poster
items.note: Institution-branded outreach copy.

items.title: Verified candidate shortlist
items.note: Mobile candidates separated from settled collaborators; every lead backed by a public profile.

items.title: Physics of the Universe cluster
items.note: Dynamos and high-energy theory in house; cosmology and phenomenology to recruit.

items.title: Formalise the IUCAA / NCRA / NCL link
items.note: Local institutes are the strongest source of mobile early-career researchers.

items.title: Operator content for the hiring pages
items.note: Not blocking current work: build from retained public data today, then reconcile authoritative records during tomorrow's migration.

items.title: Lead cosmology candidate identified
items.note: IUCAA visiting fellow, 7 years of postdocs — mobile; complements Bendre and bridges to Singh's HEP theory.

waves.title: Platform services
waves.summary: The systems behind the public site.

items.title: Research facility booking and samples
items.note: Accepted on the Mini: two synthetic users, XRD and Raman resources, two future reservations, locked bootstrap, security probe, protected backup, isolated restore, and healthy restart.

items.title: Intranet gateway
items.note: Public gateway in place; role services remain behind institutional sign-in.

items.title: Public search
items.note: Indexed across the rebuilt site.

items.title: Facilities helpdesk and service tickets
items.note: Accepted on the Mini at d92f0b0: pinned applications, healthy database and Redis, two workers, active scheduler, loopback-only frontend, and closed public route.

items.title: Research project collaboration
items.note: Independent OpenProject Community service and recovery scaffold are validated; private runtime validation is next.

items.title: Single login across Catalyst services
items.note: Separate Keycloak client provisioning is validated; activation remains deliberately deferred.

waves.title: Publication and handover
waves.summary: Getting the site live, current, and owned by the university.

items.title: Automatic publishing on every change
items.note: The public host serves from a Pages repository; the publish step is not yet automated, so the live site can lag.

items.title: Move to the campus network server
items.note: Target home for the site once the campus infrastructure is ready.

items.title: Search-engine indexing controls
items.note: Preview builds stay non-indexed; production indexing is a deliberate build input.

items.title: Administrator handover documentation
items.note: Crawler, indexing, Template Central, migration-gap, and release evidence are documented.

items.title: Catalyst operator pilot and handover
items.note: Requires synthetic end-to-end proof, backup restore, administrator exports, and operator acceptance.

items.title: Migration gap reconciliation
items.note: All Pune and Goa route gaps classified; 44 absent Goa PDFs retained as unavailable evidence.

items.title: Deterministic multi-root BFS graph
items.note: Two-origin dependency graph, typed edges, incremental fingerprints and reverse dependencies.

items.title: Google indexing and robots policy
items.note: Separate Pune and Goa canonicals, sitemaps, robots files and Search Console runbook.

items.title: Template Central promotion policy
items.note: Only data-free reviewed templates move up; immutable releases flow down during update windows.

items.title: Final artifact gate and dual push
items.note: Exact artifact, provenance gate, unchanged two-pass BFS crawl, rendered campus checks, and dual push are complete.

dates_note: Wave dates are planning estimates; completed waves show when the work actually ran.
